title: Run final Console Beta and Production UX audit
purpose: Decide whether AgentOS can claim Console Beta and identify blockers for Production Distro RC0.
scope: Parse all TASK-TUI2 JSON and evidence files.
Run workspace, TUI, replay, runbook, release and QEMU gates.
Audit full-screen shell, command palette, workbenches, catalog and evidence center boundaries.
Write final decision and next Production Distro RC0 recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Final audit includes pass/fail evidence for every wave.
Decision is one of console-beta, remediation-required or rollout-blocked.
Boundary audit confirms TUI still does not own planner, resolver, policy or side effects.
Next Production Distro RC0 tasks are listed with blockers.
failure_modes: Audit accepts a UI-only demo without executable gates.
Audit ignores scripted parity or QEMU evidence.
Console Beta claim hides production signing or fleet blockers.
